mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.2 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a preemptive monetary tightening by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates a contraction in real output, signaling an imminent recession, which leads to a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and prompts the Fed to maintain high rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant negative coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate indicates that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, suggesting a lag in rate hikes, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 208.0 and FEDFUNDS is below 4.8%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in payroll employment signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.7% and PAYEMS > 138500.0, or the interaction term is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) without a corresponding rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-driven inflation without supply-side support, which increases the risk of Fed tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is rising and INDPRO is flat or falling, or the interaction term in a predictive model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
